name: Do I need a new gas line for a pool heater if I already have other gas appliances?

mainEntity.name: Do I need a new gas line for a pool heater if I already have other gas appliances?

acceptedAnswer.text: In most cases, yes, you will likely need a new, dedicated gas line for a pool heater. Pool heaters draw a significant amount of gas, and adding one to an existing line that also supplies other appliances (like a furnace or water heater) can overwhelm the system. This can lead to insufficient gas pressure for all appliances, causing them to operate inefficiently or not at all. A separate line ensures your pool heater receives the gas flow it needs without impacting other household utilities.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, usually a dedicated new gas line is needed for a pool heater. It prevents overwhelming existing lines and ensures sufficient gas flow.
